2610.12337.title: ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration
2610.12337.paper_summary: Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.
2610.12337.paper_summary_zh: 解剖連續性為醫學影像重建提供了補充信息，但其使用需要考慮局部解剖結構和切片取樣的變異。我們介紹了ContiLNN，它通過雙向封閉形式的連續時間（Bi-CfC）模塊增強了二維重建骨幹，以進行切片間建模，同時保留平面內特徵提取。切片索引間隔調節由局部特徵和隱藏狀態決定的閘門，使得傳播能夠響應取樣變異，而無需數值ODE整合。參考引導的一致性將第一和第二階切片強度差異對齊，以保留解剖變異，同時從凍結的骨幹中進行蒸餾有助於保持平面內的真實性。在五個訓練種子中，ContiLNN在CT去噪、MRI超解析度和減少計數的PET重建方面，分別提高了平均PSNR 0.1907、1.0176和1.2482 dB，且在所有三個任務中RMSE均較低。CT結果對於一名保留的患者具有描述性。PET消融支持超出額外點狀容量的有序傳播。在連續訓練下，Bi-CfC在所有測試的取樣條件下實現了比擁有相似參數數量和算術成本的Bi-GRU更高的真實性。匹配的七切片分析顯示其延遲低52.8%和峰值GPU內存使用低57.0%相比Bi-GRU。混合間隙訓練改善了兩個運算元的稀疏和不規則上下文性能，但在指標和上下文中並未形成統一的排名。對於較少的訓練患者和第二個骨幹的實驗進一步支持了數據效率和骨幹兼容性。
